hikes.name: Marys Peak East Ridge
start: East Ridge Trail - Conner's Camp Trailhead
hikes.blurb: Through noble fir forest to the Coast Range's highest summit, a meadow with the ocean and the Cascades both in view.

hikes.name: Marys Peak Summit Meadow
hikes.blurb: A short walk from the top parking lot through wildflowers to the summit.

hikes.name: McDowell Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: A short loop past three falls, with stairs climbing beside the tallest.

hikes.name: Dimple Hill
hikes.blurb: Up through McDonald Forest to a meadow looking over Corvallis and the Willamette Valley.

hikes.name: Bald Hill
hikes.blurb: An oak savanna hill on Corvallis's edge with a view of Marys Peak.

hikes.name: Soda Creek Falls (Cascadia)
hikes.blurb: Up a mossy creek to a 150-foot falls in an old mineral-spring resort park.
